title: Imam Reza Shrine
scope: Historic exterior core with the golden tomb dome, adjacent Golden Iwan, Sahn-e Atiq arcades and its opposing gold minarets, as part of the standing Imam Reza Shrine, Mashhad.
limitations: The model represents the standing golden dome and historic Old Court exterior. Adjacent courts, teaching buildings, interiors and the extended modern complex are outside this model.

The dome and court plan are dimensioned. Subdivisions within the selected shrine mass, minaret alignments and court gate heights are estimates. Tile bands are geometric interpretations and no inscriptions or figural artworks are reproduced.
